notes: Starter list for budgeting apps. Run `python -m pipeline.draft_themes` to redraft it from a 200-review sample, edit by hand, then set frozen to true. Do not change it after full tagging starts.

themes.name: Bank connection and sync
themes.definition: Linking accounts, connections breaking, transactions missing, delayed or duplicated imports.

themes.name: Transaction categorization
themes.definition: Auto-categorization accuracy, rules, recategorizing, splitting transactions.

themes.name: Budgeting method and flexibility
themes.definition: How budgets are set up: envelopes, zero-based, rollover, flexible or custom budget periods.

themes.name: Pricing and subscription
themes.definition: Price level, price increases, free tier limits, trials, cancellation and refunds.

themes.name: Reports and insights
themes.definition: Charts, spending trends, net worth, cash-flow views, exports of reports.

themes.name: Ease of use and design
themes.definition: Learning curve, navigation, onboarding, visual design, clutter.

themes.name: Performance and stability
themes.definition: Crashes, slowness, freezes, data not saving, app-update regressions.

themes.name: Investments and net worth
themes.definition: Tracking investment, retirement, crypto, property or loan balances.

themes.name: Bills and subscription tracking
themes.definition: Recurring bill detection, reminders, cancelling subscriptions through the app.

themes.name: Shared and household finances
themes.definition: Couples, partners, family members sharing budgets or accounts.

themes.name: Goals and savings
themes.definition: Savings goals, debt payoff plans, progress tracking.

themes.name: Platform and device support
themes.definition: Web vs mobile parity, tablet, widgets, watch, offline use, missing platforms.

themes.name: Customer support and trust
themes.definition: Support responsiveness, account issues, privacy, security, data ownership.

themes.name: Switching and import
themes.definition: Moving from another app (for example Mint), importing history or CSV files.

themes.name: Other
themes.definition: Anything that fits none of the themes above.
